verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no region or residency selector for Datalab's hosted service. Data location can only be controlled by running Datalab's models on your own infrastructure, including air-gapped or Kubernetes/Helm deployments, and that requires an Enterprise contract aimed at regulated, privacy-sensitive teams. This is an indirect, enterprise-gated route to residency rather than a choice users can make themselves. Missing for 10: region selection for the hosted cloud and its file storage, documented residency guarantees (e.g. EU/US data centers), self-serve residency outside Enterprise, and independent corroboration.
